title: Conformance fixture manifest
description: The inputs to one conformance case. See fixtures/README.md for the on-disk shape and PROBE.md for how these fields reach the probe.

name.description: MUST equal the fixture directory name. The runner rejects a mismatch.

description.description: What this case asserts, in one sentence, in behavior terms.

specClause.description: The SPEC.md section this expectation was hand-derived from, as a bare section number.

cwd.description: Path relative to tree/ that becomes --cwd. May be nested, to exercise the upward walk.

home.description: Path relative to tree/ that becomes --home.

env.description: The complete environment for the prefixed env-var layer. Values may contain the token ${TREE}, which the runner replaces with the absolute path of this fixture's tree/ directory.

options.description: The load options from SPEC section 6, passed verbatim as --options.

expectError.description: Presence means this case asserts a failure: the probe must exit 1 and emit an error document.

kind.description: The closed error kind from SPEC section 5.

path.description: Fixture-root-relative path the error must name. Omit when the error has no path.

skipOn.description: Platforms that cannot express this case. Matched against the runner's platform identifier.

chmod.description: Files the runner sets to a given octal mode before the case and restores afterward. Keys are paths relative to tree/; values are octal mode strings such as "000".
